Question ID: CW_U03_L02_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.FIC.06

Passage A: Rina gave her last pencil to a classmate before the exam. Passage B: Omar shared his umbrella even though his own sleeve got soaked. What shared theme is best supported?

answer.text: School supplies and umbrellas are the same object.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The objects differ; the theme connection is generosity.

answer.text: Weather is always more important than school.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Only Passage B includes weather. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: Helping others can require giving up personal comfort or convenience.

feedback.text: Correct. Question ID: CW_U03_L02_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.FIC.06

Passage A: Eli practiced alone until he could play the song. Passage B: Jada asked three classmates for help before she understood the dance steps. Which comparison is strongest?

answer.text: Both passages are identical because they include names.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Names are surface details, not theme development.

answer.text: Passage A has music, so Passage B has no theme.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Different activities can still develop related themes.

answer.text: Passage B is only about three classmates.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The classmates help develop the theme of learning with support.

answer.text: Both passages show learning through effort, but one emphasizes independent practice while the other emphasizes help from others.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer is supported by MLA.CW.FIC.06 because it selects a specific craft move or revision decision: "Both passages show learning through effort, but one emphasizes independent practice while the other emphasizes help from others.".
